# Lin Chih-han Lin Chih-han Taiwanese Go player (born 1980) | Personal information | | --- | | Fullname | Lin Chih-han | | Born | (1980-11-14) 14 November 1980 (age45)
[Taiwan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taiwan "Taiwan") | | Sport | | | | [Rank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_ranks_and_ratings "Go ranks and ratings") | 9 dan | | Affiliation | [Taiwan Qiyuan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taiwan_Qiyuan "Taiwan Qiyuan") | | | Lin Chih-han **Lin Chih-han** ( [Chinese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_language "Chinese language"):林至涵; [pinyin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinyin "Pinyin"): _Lín Zhìhán_; born 14 November 1980) is a [Taiwanese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taiwanese_people "Taiwanese people") [professional](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_professional "Go professional") [Go](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_(game) "Go (game)") [player](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_players "Go players"). ## Promotion record | Rank | Year | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 [dan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_ranks_and_ratings#Kyu_and_dan_ranks "Go ranks and ratings") | 2001 | | | 2 dan | 2001 | | | 3 dan | 2002 | | | 4 dan | 2003 | | | 5 dan | 2003 | | | 6 dan | 2004 | | | 7 dan | 2004 | | | 8 dan | 2007 | | | 9 dan | 2009 | | ## Career record - **2006**: 42 wins, 19 losses[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lin_Chih-han#cite_note-1) - **2007**: 35 wins, 18 losses[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lin_Chih-han#cite_note-2) - **2008**: 65 wins, 27 losses[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lin_Chih-han#cite_note-3) - **2009**: 33 wins, 18 losses[\[4\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lin_Chih-han#cite_note-4) - **2010**: 47 wins, 22 losses[\[5\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lin_Chih-han#cite_note-5) ##
